project.name: Inventory API
project.description: A fictional example used to demonstrate dependency-aware task coordination.

tasks.title: Define inventory data model
tasks.description: Define inventory item fields and reorder threshold semantics.

tasks.title: Implement inventory repository
tasks.description: Create repository functions to list and retrieve inventory items.

tasks.title: Implement low-stock endpoint
tasks.description: Return items whose current quantity is at or below their reorder threshold.
acceptance_criteria: Items at the threshold are included.
Items above the threshold are excluded.
A missing item list returns an empty list.

tasks.title: Add inventory endpoint tests
tasks.description: Add tests for inventory API responses.
acceptance_criteria: An empty inventory list is covered.

tasks.title: Review API security
tasks.description: Review input validation and data exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid request data is handled safely.

tasks.title: Review release changes
tasks.description: Review the complete diff and release notes.
